title: THE BOYS PACK
description: The pack adds The Boys Universe
body:
**_THE BOYS PACK_**

The Boys are a team of vigilantes, a CIA squad for covert operations. Their mission is to track and potentially shut down the activities of the Seven, a group of vainglorious superheroes.
